headline: Base Lines Buckle Across Six Active Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the heaviest movement has shifted toward a still-active belt of contested sectors. PalantineBerm now records 53 strategic-base events in the rolling day, including nine in the latest two hours, with holdings at two Warden and five Colonial bases. WeatheredExpanse has risen to 49 events, eight in two hours, while its casualty and enlistment rates accelerate; six Warden bases remain, alongside three neutral positions. LinnMercy stands at 36 events, with eight in the latest two hours, and continues to show nine Colonial bases, two neutral, and no Warden-held base. Stonecradle has reached 21 events, including one in the latest two hours, amid renewed acceleration in both casualty columns. MarbanHollow remains divided four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral, with 29 events on the day but none in the last two hours. StlicanShelf has eight daily events and five in six hours, while its combat and enlistment rates are sharply rising. Gutter, earlier a lively front, now shows 11 daily events but no movement in the latest two hours.
